load_state_dict_model: load a PyTorch model's state dict from a pretrained checkpoint with automatic prefix stripping and key alignment
align_and_update_state_dicts: align and update a model's state dict keys to match a loaded pretrained checkpoint using suffix matching
strip_prefix_if_present: strip a common prefix like module. from all state dict keys if every key has it
review_align_and_update_state_dicts: review the align_and_update_state_dicts function that matches model keys to loaded keys by longest suffix match
summarize_load_state_dict: summarize the load_state_dict function that strips module prefixes and aligns keys before loading into a model
